verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs say users can build custom agents in-product. They can describe a workflow in natural language to create an agent, then define its goal and set its rules (monday-docs-13, monday-docs-14). Further configuration comes from admin-scoped board access, auditing (monday-docs-10), agent skills (monday-docs-44), and interaction through @mentions and assignments (monday-docs-11). missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of the agent-builder configuration options, and independent or hands-on corroboration that custom agent building works as claimed.
